decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's strategy while developing a strong board presence with creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Stoneforge Mystic. The deck utilizes cards like Aether Vial and Recruiter of the Guard to efficiently tutor for key pieces and maintain pressure on the opponent. It also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the goal is to apply pressure while controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's resources.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly dump high-value creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into the graveyard and then use reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back into play for a powerful combo. The deck also utilizes cards like Faithless Looting, Unmask, and Thoughtseize to set up your graveyard and disrupt your opponent's game plan. With a focus on reanimating creatures for big plays and overwhelming your opponent with powerful threats, this deck aims to win the game through explosive combos and efficient graveyard recursion.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Aluren combo by using cards like Show and Tell, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Acererak the Archlich to cheat out powerful creatures like Omniscience and then use Aluren to cast multiple creatures for free. This combo enables the player to generate a lot of value and potentially win the game on the spot. The deck also includes cards like Force of Will and Veil of Summer to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main goal of this deck is to control the tempo of the game by using disruption spells like Force of Will, Thoughtseize, and Daze, while building pressure with aggressive creatures like Bilbo, Thief in the Night and Nethergoyf. By utilizing cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to filter through the deck, as well as utilizing Mishra's Bauble for additional information, this deck aims to maintain a constant threat on the board while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The mana base is focused on providing consistency and access to both blue and black sources.

The main strategy of this Death & Taxes Aggro deck is to control the board through disruptive creatures and removal spells while maximizing value with cards like Recruiter of the Guard and Skyclave Apparition. The deck also utilizes Aether Vial to cheat out creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With the addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as the companion, the deck aims to generate incremental advantage over time through flickering creatures for extra value. Overall, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan to secure a victory.

The deck aims to control the game by utilizing powerful spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's strategy while ramping up mana quickly with Cloudpost and Tron lands. The deck includes strong control elements like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its key pieces, as well as powerful win conditions like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and Karn, the Great Creator. With access to plenty of mana and a variety of versatile spells, the deck looks to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through a combination of disruption and powerful threats.

The main focus of this Dimir Tempo deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and counter magic such as Force of Will, while applying pressure with efficient threats like Nethergoyf and Brazen Borrower. The deck also utilizes cheap removal spells like Fatal Push and Snuff Out to maintain control of the board. The deck's mana base is designed to be efficient and consistent, with the ability to disrupt the opponent's mana base using cards like Wasteland.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful combo pieces like Doomsday, Thassa's Oracle, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to quickly assemble a winning combination. It also includes disruption like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo, as well as card selection tools like Ponder and Brainstorm to find key pieces efficiently. The deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary cards to win the game and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure victory.

The main concept of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana using Ancient Tomb, Eldrazi Temple, and Eye of Ugin in order to play powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Sire of Seven Deaths and It That Heralds the End. Chalice of the Void is used to disrupt opponents' game plans, while Thought-Knot Seer provides disruption and card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, aggressive plays and powerful creatures, backed up by disruptive spells like Eldrazi Confluence and Kozilek's Command.

The key concept of this deck is to control the board through disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, while using aggressive creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Barrowgoyf to pressure the opponent. The deck also aims to tempo out the opponent with cards like Daze and Brazen Borrower, keeping the opponent on the back foot while maintaining card advantage with cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Brainstorm. The mana base is designed to support the deck's strategy of disrupting the opponent's game plan while efficiently deploying threats.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while also applying pressure with efficient threats. Utilizing disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, along with tempo plays like Daze and Wasteland, the deck aims to control the game's pace. The creatures in the deck, such as Murktide Regent and Barrowgoyf, provide a clock for the opponent to deal with while also being resilient threats. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps filter through the deck and generate card advantage. Overall, the deck seeks to disrupt the opponent's strategy while deploying threats to close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on deploying aggressive Eldrazi creatures quickly using powerful mana acceleration cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide. It uses disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void and Thorn of Amethyst to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also utilizing Eldrazi Temple and Eye of Ugin to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Reality Smasher and Thought-Knot Seer. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and disruptive start, backed up by resilient threats and land destruction.

The key concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt opponents' game plans with counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Murktide Regent and Quantum Riddler. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps draw cards and control the board, while Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd provides incremental value with lifegain and token generation. The deck also utilizes versatile lands like Wasteland and Mystic Sanctuary to further control the flow of the game. By efficiently managing resources and controlling the pace of the game, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents to secure victory.

The main concept of this Aluren combo deck is to utilize cards like Acererak the Archlich and Aluren to quickly and efficiently cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Veil of Summer to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Show and Tell and Omniscience provide additional ways to cheat out big threats, while cards like Stock Up and Ponder help dig for key pieces. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and combo potential.

The focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will while maintaining pressure with efficient threats like Orcish Bowmasters and Murktide Regent. Using cards like Daze and Wasteland, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and prevent the opponent from stabilizing. By utilizing a mix of hand disruption, removal spells, and creatures with evasion, the deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can recover.

The main concept of this UR Tempo deck is to quickly control the board and apply pressure to the opponent with efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to tempo the opponent out of the game by utilizing cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the right answers while also utilizing efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The mana base includes fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent mana access for the aggressive and disruptive game plan.
